configuration.title: OAIProxy
config.logLevel.description: Debug log level. Logs are written to ~/.copilot/oaiproxy/logs/ as JSON lines. Default is 'off' (no logging).
config.baseUrl.description: The base URL for the Openai Compatible Inference API. Default value is Hugging Face.
config.models.description: A list of preferred models to use. If provided, these models will be used directly instead of fetching from the API.
config.models._comment.description: Human-readable note for generated model presets. This is configuration metadata only and is not sent to model providers.
config.models.displayName.description: (Optional) Display name for the model that will be shown in the Copilot interface. If not provided, will be generated automatically.
config.models.configId.description: (Optional) Configuration ID for this model. Allows defining the same model with different settings (e.g. 'glm-4.6::thinking', 'glm-4.6::no-thinking').
config.models.family.description: Model family (e.g., 'gpt-4', 'claude-3', 'gemini'). Enables model-specific optimizations and behaviors. Defaults to 'OAIProxy' if not specified.
config.models.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the model provider. If not provided, the global oaicopilot.baseUrl will be used.
config.models.context_length.description: Model support context length. Default is 128000.
config.models.max_input_tokens.descripti: Optional advertised input token budget for VS Code/OAIProxy preflight checks. Use this to leave provider-specific safety margin without changing context_length or output token parameters.
config.models.vision.description: Model support vision. Default is false.
config.models.toolCalling.description: Advertise tool calling support to VS Code. Set false to avoid Agent optimized tool selection latency for this model.
config.models.max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (range: [1, context_length)). Default is 4096.
config.models.max_completion_tokens.desc: Maximum number of tokens to generate (OpenAI new standard parameter).
Expose VS Code's per-model Thinking Effort control for this model.
config.models.supported_reasoning_effort: Supported values for VS Code's per-model Thinking Effort control. DeepSeek defaults to high, max. Other models default to minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max.
config.models.default_reasoning_effort.d: Default value for VS Code's per-model Thinking Effort control. If not set, reasoning_effort is used.
config.models.thinking.description: Thinking configuration for providers that expose an explicit thinking mode, such as Zai, Anthropic, and MiniMax M3.
config.models.thinking.type.description: Set to 'enabled' to enable thinking, 'disabled' to disable thinking, or 'adaptive' for Anthropic adaptive thinking.
config.models.thinking.clear_thinking.de: For Z.AI/GLM-compatible endpoints, set false to preserve historical reasoning_content across turns.
config.models.enable_thinking.descriptio: Switches between thinking and non-thinking modes. Not required.
config.models.thinking_budget.descriptio: Maximum number of tokens for chain-of-thought output. Not required.
config.models.temperature.description: Sampling temperature (range: [0, 2]). Lower values make output more deterministic, higher values make it more creative. Default is 0.
config.models.top_k.description: Top-k sampling value (range: [1, Infinity)). Not required.
config.models.reasoning.effort.descripti: Reasoning effort level for OpenRouter/xAI (high, medium, low, minimal, auto)
config.models.reasoning.exclude.descript: Exclude reasoning tokens from the final response
config.models.reasoning.max_tokens.descr: Specific token limit for reasoning (Anthropic-style, alternative to effort)
config.models.reasoning.enabled.descript: Enable reasoning (inferred from effort or max_tokens if not specified)
config.models.prompt_cache.description: Prompt/KV cache configuration. OpenAI prompt-cache keys are auto-applied only for official OpenAI endpoints unless explicitly configured. Known Anthropic-compatible endpoints add stable-prefix cache_control unless disabled. Providers such as DeepSeek, MiMo, MiniMax OpenAI mode, and Gemini use provider-managed cache hits.
config.models.prompt_cache.enabled.descr: Enable provider-safe prompt cache request shaping. Set false to disable automatic cache parameters.
config.models.prompt_cache.key.descripti: Optional OpenAI prompt_cache_key override for requests with shared prompt prefixes.
config.models.prompt_cache.retention.des: Optional OpenAI prompt_cache_retention. Leave unset for provider default.
config.models.prompt_cache.anthropic.ena: Enable Anthropic cache_control on stable system/tool prefixes. Known first-party Anthropic-compatible endpoints enable this by default unless prompt_cache.enabled is false.
config.models.prompt_cache.anthropic.ttl: Anthropic cache lifetime. Default 5m uses provider default wire shape; 1h sends ttl.
config.models.prompt_cache.anthropic.cac: Add cache_control to system prompts when Anthropic prompt cache is enabled.
Add cache_control to tool definitions when Anthropic prompt cache is enabled.
config.models.extra_body.description: LiteLLM/OpenAI-SDK-style provider-specific request body parameters. In apiMode 'litellm', these are sent as the literal extra_body field.
config.models.headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to be sent with every request to this model's provider. These headers will be merged with the default headers (Authorization, Content-Type, User-Agent).
config.models.include_reasoning_in_reque: Whether to include reasoning_content in assistant messages sent to the API. Supports DeepSeek, MiMo thinking mode, and other compatible providers.
config.models.apiMode.description: API mode: 'openai' (Default) for OpenAI Chat Completions (/chat/completions; Kimi, DeepSeek, MiMo, MiniMax, etc.), 'litellm' for LiteLLM Proxy Chat Completions (/chat/completions with extra_body support), 'openai-responses' for OpenAI Responses (/responses), 'ollama' for Ollama (/api/chat), 'anthropic' for Anthropic (/v1/messages), 'gemini' for Gemini (*/v1beta/models/{model}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse).
config.models.useForCommitGeneration.des: Whether to be used for Git commit message generation. Not supports gemini apiMode.
config.models.delay.description: Model-specific delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests. If not specified, falls back to global oaicopilot.delay configuration.
config.retry.description: Retry configuration for handling api errors like [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].
config.retry.enabled.description: Enable retry mechanism for api errors. Default is true.
config.retry.max_attempts.description: Maximum number of retry attempts. Default is 3.
config.retry.interval_ms.description: Interval between retry attempts in milliseconds. Default is 1000 (1 seconds).
config.retry.status_codes.description: Additional HTTP status codes that will be merged. Default is [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].
config.delay.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests. Default is 0 (no delay).
config.commitLanguage.description: Language for generated Git commit messages. Default is English.
config.commitMessagePrompt.description: Custom system prompt for commit message generation. If not provided, uses the default prompt.
config.readFileLines.description: Number of lines to read when using `read_file` tool. Large lines may cost more tokens. Default is 0, let model decide lines.
config.visionBridgeModel.description: Vision bridge model used to describe images for text-only models. Can be any registered language model id (for example 'Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct'). Leave empty to automatically pick the first configured model with "vision": true.
config.visionBridgePrompt.description: Custom prompt used by the vision bridge to describe images. Leave empty to use the default prompt: 'Describe this image. Include visible text, code, UI, diagrams, and other important details.'
